questions.author: llm
questions.question: How much does the Fiber 500 plan cost per month?

supports.fact: The Fiber 500 plan costs 79 dollars per month.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What is the monthly price of Fiber 1000?

supports.fact: The Fiber 1000 plan costs 99 dollars per month.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How much premium mobile data is included on Unlimited Talk?

supports.fact: The Unlimited Talk plan includes 50 gigabytes of premium mobile data.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: When does the Prepaid 30 plan expire?

supports.fact: The Prepaid 30 plan expires 30 days after activation.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What discount do I get for autopay?

supports.fact: Autopay gives a 5 dollar monthly discount.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: When is a late fee posted, and how much is it?

supports.fact: A late fee of 10 dollars is posted on day 15 after the due date.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Do I need paperless billing to get the autopay discount?

supports.fact: Paperless billing is required to receive the autopay discount.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Which payment methods does Northline accept?

supports.fact: Northline accepts Visa, Mastercard, and ACH bank drafts.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What happens if I do not return the gateway on time?

supports.fact: A gateway not returned within 21 days is billed at 150 dollars.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How is the early termination fee calculated?

supports.fact: The early termination fee is 12 dollars for each month remaining on a term contract.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What does standard installation cost if I am home for the window?

supports.fact: Standard installation is 0 dollars when the customer is home for a two-hour window.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How much does it cost to move existing fiber service?

supports.fact: A move of existing fiber service costs 40 dollars.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Is roaming in Canada and Mexico included on Unlimited Talk?

supports.fact: International roaming in Canada and Mexico is included on the Unlimited Talk plan.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What speed do I get after I use the premium mobile data allowance?

supports.fact: After the premium data allowance, mobile speeds are reduced to 2 Mbps.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What do I need in order to reset my account PIN?

supports.fact: Account PIN resets require the last four digits of the account number and a one-time text code.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What hours is phone support open?

supports.fact: Phone support is open from 08:00 to 20:00 Eastern Time every day.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: When can a residential customer request a credit for an outage?

supports.fact: A continuous outage of 12 hours or more qualifies a residential customer to request a one-day service credit.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: If I downgrade Fiber 1000 to Fiber 500, when does the change take effect and what happens to the price difference?

supports.fact: Plan changes requested before noon Eastern Time take effect the next billing date.
If a customer downgrades Fiber 1000 to Fiber 500, the price difference is credited on the following invoice and is not returned as cash.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How quickly is a severity 1 outage escalated, and to whom?

supports.fact: Severity 1 outages are escalated to the network duty manager within 15 minutes.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How large a goodwill credit can a finance analyst approve without a second signature?

supports.fact: A finance analyst may approve a goodwill credit up to 50 dollars without a second signature.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What does a household pay each billing cycle for the mid-tier home connection?

supports.fact: The Fiber 500 plan costs 79 dollars per month.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: If a bill sits unpaid for two weeks, what extra amount is added?

supports.fact: A late fee of 10 dollars is posted on day 15 after the due date.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: During which clock span can a person reach a live voice rather than typed messages?

supports.fact: Phone support is open from 08:00 to 20:00 Eastern Time every day.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How many weeks may the rented modem stay out once the subscription has ended, before a bill appears?

supports.fact: A gateway not returned within 21 days is billed at 150 dollars.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: When half a neighborhood loses connectivity entirely, who is paged, and how soon?

supports.fact: Severity 1 outages are escalated to the network duty manager within 15 minutes.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Without asking the ledger desk, how much of a billing cycle can frontline staff restore after a long failure?

supports.fact: Agents may apply an outage credit of at most 3 days without finance approval.

questions.question: What spoken token lets a price cut for someone about to leave be checked later?

supports.fact: AGENT_CANARY_4QP9

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How soon must someone answer a second-rank case?

supports.fact: Priority 2 tickets have a first-response target of 4 hours.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How long may someone who is holding be left before the promised ring-back?

supports.fact: The callback SLA for a waiting customer is 30 minutes during phone support hours.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: After the secret digits are confirmed, how long until it can move to a different company?

supports.fact: A port-out request is completed in 1 business day after the account PIN is verified.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What should frontline staff have the household do on a cable, rather than over the air, prior to escalating outside the house?

supports.fact: Agents ask the customer to run the in-app speed test on a wired connection before opening a network ticket.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What must be checked before service is moved onto a replacement card?

supports.fact: Agents verify the account PIN before moving a line to a new SIM.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Which pair of proofs lets frontline staff discuss money?

supports.fact: Before an agent discusses charges, the customer must pass one of these checks: the account PIN, or the one-time text code plus the last four digits of the account number.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What is the largest courtesy adjustment someone on the ledger team can post alone?

supports.fact: A finance analyst may approve a goodwill credit up to 50 dollars without a second signature.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Past what amount does a reversal of money already collected need the person who leads the ledger team?

supports.fact: A refund above 100 dollars requires the finance director.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: How long does the ledger group have to respond to a dispute from the company that issued the plastic?

supports.fact: A chargeback notice must be answered within 7 calendar days.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Who files a correction when the taxing region on a bill was incorrect?

supports.fact: A tax adjustment request is filed by the finance team, not by a store agent.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Who alone may clear a sum that has sat unpaid for a quarter and is larger than two hundred?

supports.fact: Accounts above 200 dollars past due for 90 days may be written off only by the finance director.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Which role must sign when a gesture sent over by the corner suite exceeds one hundred fifty?

supports.fact: An executive courtesy credit above 150 dollars requires the finance director.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: Is there an extra cost for closing out a handset ahead of schedule, and what is left out of that figure?

supports.fact: A device installment plan can be settled early with no prepayment penalty.
The payoff amount is the remaining principal and does not include future service charges.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: What stops funds from being sent back while a suspicion marker is set, and who can lift that marker?

supports.fact: A refund or credit is held when the account has an open fraud flag.
Only the fraud desk can clear the flag.

questions.author: llm
questions.question: After how long is a delinquent file passed to an external agency, if it was not cleared and no special deal is running?

supports.fact: An account is handed to the outside collection desk after 120 days past due if it was not written off and no hardship arrangement is active.
